title: Austria Tests Its Limits: Headscarf Ban and Economic Strain Define a Nation… · 11 Sep
keywords: Austria, headscarf ban, religious freedom, Constitutional Court, integration policy, GDP, inflation, WIFO, economic recovery, EU policy, Austrian politics, cost of living, Muslim community, school law, consumer confidence
notes: Austria is navigating two of its most consequential domestic fault lines simultaneously: a school headscarf ban for girls under 14 that courts may yet strike down, and an economy that official data describe as stabilising but that millions of households still experience as painful. The two debates, one a charged identity question and the other a technical yet deeply personal economic argument, together reveal the tensions shaping Austrian politics heading into the autumn legislative calendar. How Vienna resolves each will carry lessons well beyond its borders.
